caption: The drawing depicts a single duck oriented to the right, with its body in profile. The duck has a greenish-yellow bill and a light brown head with small dark speckles. Its neck and upper chest are pale brown, transitioning into a darker, patterned, grayish-brown body. The feathers on its body feature crescent-shaped patterns outlined in a light tan shade. The duck's wing has a distinctive patch of teal green bordered with black and yellow. The tail is pointed and brown with lighter edges. The background is plain and uncolored, making the duck the sole subject of the composition.
title: Decoy Duck
